title: FD maturity, renewal and receipts - explained
content: At maturity, a fixed deposit follows its recorded instruction, such as crediting proceeds or renewal where permitted. The renewal terms can differ from the original booking. A deposit receipt and nominee record serve distinct documentation purposes.
